_about: Icon manifest for bin/bookmarklet-favicon. Keys are bookmark names. An entry can be a spec, or {"icon": spec, "match": text} where the text is part of the bookmarklet's code, such as the app address it calls: a code match survives a rename, a removed name, and a new version of the code. Name keys ignore emoji and symbols, so 'Wayback' also matches '🕰️ Wayback'. Specs: emoji:X, symbol:material_name, text:AB, file:path, like:https://site/, url:https://site/. A relative file: path resolves against this folder, and {size} in it names art drawn for each bar size (16 and 32). Options after a comma: bg=#hex, fg=#hex, fill=0|1, wght=100..700, opsz=20..48. Each icon comes from the app the bookmarklet belongs to. The two text-unlock bookmarklets have no app, so they get Material Symbols on #3297fd, the selection blue the Unlock bookmarklet paints.
